item.description:
What's new

  • Added automatic updates. WonderWhisper now checks for new versions once a day and can download and install them for you, so you no longer need to fetch a disk image by hand. Updates are verified against the developer signature before installing, which means your macOS permissions carry over untouched.
  • Added Check for Updates to the WonderWhisper app menu, the menu bar icon, and Settings.

Notes

  • This is the first release with built-in updating. Future versions will offer themselves automatically from here.
  • Existing recordings, history, settings, permissions, and Keychain credentials remain compatible.
